decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of three years beginning with the date of this consent.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted ( Design and Access Statement, Location Plan, Drawing Numbers 489 SVY 01, 489 WD 100, 489 WD 104, 489 WD 701 received 06/12/12. ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - Where possible, and in the case of intervention in original walls, nib and/or downstands should be retained to show the historical past of the buildings.

Condition : 4 - This consent does not permit the demolition or dismantling of any part of the buildings, or the removal of any feature, floor, wall or ceiling surface, except in so far as the alterations and extension hereby approved necessitate the removal of certain parts of the existing structure as specifically shown on the approved drawings.

Condition : 5 - No development shall take place until samples of the materials to be used in the construction of the hereby permitted have been submitted to and approved in writing by the local planning authority.  Development shall be carried out in accordance with the approved details.
description: Works to a listed building to lower modern floor in the catering store, open up a blocked up arch in the babcock room to form a new teapoint and provision of a new accessible WC in the main entrance area and associated works
